description.narrative: The target countries of Democratic Republic of Congo, Malawi and Madagascar remain unchanged for year two of this three year programme. These three countries are 1. Amongst the 15 worst affected countries by the current food and nutrition crisis; 2. Are GAP frontrunner countries and have government_x0002_endorsed operational roadmaps with clear, costed targets; 3. Have the policy environment and operational readiness to scale up the selected actions in the proposed timeframe; For Use from 13/02/24 Standard ARA Year 2024 4. Have received funding for complementary activities ensuring that the continuum of prevention-detection-treatment of child wasting that can be adequately delivered. Sub-national areas within these countries were selected for specific interventions as identified in the outcomes/indicators. These are aligned with the GAP country roadmaps and have been selected to maximize the convergence of complementar actions
